name: Chijoku no Koushuu Niku Benki
source:
The main character starts to work at a school in the backwoods. The area is famous for onsen, and many tourists visit there. He stays temporarily at a hotel until he finds an apartment to live. There are only three girls at his class...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090301140858/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006156]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公前往一所偏远的学校任教。该地区以温泉闻名，吸引了许多游客。在找到公寓之前，他暂住在一家旅馆里。他的班上只有三个女生……

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090301140858/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1006156]Eroge Shop[/url]]
